description: Monorepo: two uv-managed Python services (etls/absgame, etls/real-estate) and one npm frontend (frontend). The uv lockfiles already track their own resolution, and the frontend lockfile is kept in sync by npm, so lockFileMaintenance is scoped to Nix only.

packageRules.description: Group Nix flake input updates into a single PR
Group non-major CI action updates in .forgejo/workflows; major bumps get their own PR
Only refresh flake.lock via lockFileMaintenance; npm and uv lockfiles are already kept in sync by their package managers
Hold TypeScript at 6.x: TS 7 is the native (tsgo) compiler and drops the JS compiler API vue-tsc depends on (see vuejs/language-tools#5381). Remove once vue-tsc supports TS 7.

customManagers.description: Track the Python version in each .python-version, preserving the +gil suffix uv pins
Update the pnpm version pinned in flake.nix permittedInsecurePackages
Keep the Biome schema URL version in biome.json in sync with the @biomejs/biome package
